experience.title: Senior Web & CMS Developer
responsibilities: Build responsive websites and conversion-focused landing pages using Webflow, WordPress, Shopify, JavaScript, and React.js for clients and agency partners.
Translate Figma and UI/UX designs into production-ready interfaces; implement reusable components, CMS templates, and dynamic content structures.
Develop custom frontend functionality, forms, animations, REST API connections, and third-party integrations.
Collaborate with design and CRO teams to implement A/B tests and user-journey improvements; integrate GA4, pixels, events, and conversion tracking.
Optimize page speed, accessibility, responsiveness, technical SEO, and usability; debug and maintain existing websites using Git and AI-assisted workflows.
